limitations: all state is a throwaway SQLite database under the drill workdir; no live service, credential or operator database is touched
RPO is the age of the newest committed record when the snapshot started; a one-shot snapshot does not bound loss after it
RTO is measured on this host for the seeded fixture; it is not an SLA and does not model a cold machine or remote storage
deployment-ring state is in-memory per controller; the durable record is the audit trail written by the drill

a tenant-scoped snapshot uses the declared tenant tables in backup.py, which do not include bos_event; the drill reports event-index replay as not applicable for that scope (a whole-database drill replays it)
the kill-switch scheduler/gateway/egress stoppers are injected drill callables; the leases stopper is the shipped Business OS lease release
provider cancellation is represented by the injected egress stopper; no real provider, network or credential is contacted
no full repository matrix was run; this is a focused P8-03 gate
